summary: This Form 8-K filed by American Woodmark Corp. reports that the FTC has closed its investigation and the HSR waiting period has expired for its merger with MasterBrand, Inc. Under the Agreement and Plan of Merger dated August 5, 2025, MasterBrand will acquire American Woodmark via a merger subsidiary. The transaction is expected to close on or about May 28, 2026, subject to customary conditions. No price or premium is disclosed in this filing. The board has not issued a new recommendation here. The expiration of the HSR period removes a key regulatory hurdle, leaving only customary closing conditions. Watch for any lingering shareholder litigation or financing contingencies that could delay close.
